sonnet.problem: Card 4 already asked and answered verse 38, that God gives the seed its body. Card 5 retells the same verse and adds only a joke, so it moves the baker nowhere new in the passage.
sonnet.rule: Every story card moves the baker forward through the passage. No recap cards.

sonnet.problem: The right answer is the Bible's own phrase, 'In the twinkling of an eye', while the two wrong answers are plain modern spans of days. The right answer stands out. The two wrong answers ('Over forty days' and 'Across seven days') also mean nearly the same thing, a span of days.
sonnet.rule: Don't let the right answer stand out. All the answers should sound alike. None should sound more like the Bible, or more modern, than the others.
